description: This file defines the AOS_Products class, which extends AOS_Products_sugar, adding custom functionality for product handling in SuiteCRM, including GUID generation, image upload processing, and custom database queries.

classes.name: AOS_Products
classes.description: A class extending AOS_Products_sugar with custom methods for GUID generation, image upload, and complex queries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: getGUID
methods.description: Generates a UUID using either PHP's com_create_guid() if available or a manual method.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to handle image upload validation, processing, and then calls the parent save.

methods.name: getCustomersPurchasedProductsQuery
methods.description: Returns a SQL query to retrieve products purchased by customers, involving complex joins on quotes, accounts, and products.
